loot/food/before/line_01.wav.text: You must be starving after coming all this way. So I made a few things I thought you might like.
loot/food/before/line_01.wav.direction: Warm, nurturing and excited to feed the player, slightly overprotective; no hostility.

loot/food/before/line_02.wav.text: I’ve been cooking all evening, and I may have gotten a little carried away. But that just means there’s plenty for you.
loot/food/before/line_02.wav.direction: Warm, nurturing and excited to feed the player, slightly overprotective; no hostility.

loot/food/before/line_03.wav.text: Before we do anything else, you need something proper to eat. I made all of this especially for you.
loot/food/before/line_03.wav.direction: Warm, nurturing and excited to feed the player, slightly overprotective; no hostility.

loot/food/after/line_01.wav.text: Go on, take as much as you like. You never have to worry about going hungry while you’re here.
loot/food/after/line_01.wav.direction: Affectionate, satisfied, lightly manipulative; pleased at how well she provides.

loot/food/after/line_02.wav.text: There. That should keep you happy for a while. And if you want more, you only have to ask.
loot/food/after/line_02.wav.direction: Affectionate, satisfied, lightly manipulative; pleased at how well she provides.

loot/food/after/line_03.wav.text: I knew you’d like it. Everything tastes better when somebody actually takes the time to make it for you.
loot/food/after/line_03.wav.direction: Affectionate, satisfied, lightly manipulative; pleased at how well she provides.

loot/treasure/before/line_01.wav.text: I noticed how hard you work for everything back home, so I thought I’d save you the trouble this time.
loot/treasure/before/line_01.wav.direction: Generous, confident, indulgent and lightly teasing; life is easier here.

loot/treasure/before/line_02.wav.text: I found a few little things I thought you deserved. They’re much too nice to leave sitting around collecting dust.
loot/treasure/before/line_02.wav.direction: Generous, confident, indulgent and lightly teasing; life is easier here.

loot/treasure/before/line_03.wav.text: You spend so much time searching for things like these. Here, you don’t have to search at all.
loot/treasure/before/line_03.wav.direction: Generous, confident, indulgent and lightly teasing; life is easier here.

loot/treasure/after/line_01.wav.text: Keep it. All of it. There’s plenty more where that came from.
loot/treasure/after/line_01.wav.direction: Smugly generous, warm and subtly persuasive, not excessively dramatic.

loot/treasure/after/line_02.wav.text: See how easy things can be here? No digging, no fighting, no wasting your time.
loot/treasure/after/line_02.wav.direction: Smugly generous, warm and subtly persuasive, not excessively dramatic.

loot/treasure/after/line_03.wav.text: Much nicer than spending all day underground looking for scraps, isn’t it?
